editorial_method: Primary-source review; no account or live workflow tested.

zh.summary: 按自然语言与规格生成可编辑 SVG 矢量图。
zh.judgment: 专业场景的切口是可修改且准确的交付；输出好看不能替代尺寸与信息正确。
zh.replaces: 设计者画信息图和图表，再手工调整标签、几何与品牌规范。
zh.product: 官网展示图表、科学示意和产品图等例子，并强调准确、可编辑的 SVG。当前主要入口是候补，不能声称已开放完整自助购买。
zh.customer: 设计师、技术传播与教育内容团队是潜在客户。需求来自重复绘制有规格的视觉材料，付款理由应是减少后续修正，而不仅是第一张图片更快。
zh.workflow: 公司描述输入目标并输出 SVG。应检查文字、数值、几何关系和导入设计工具后的编辑性；本次未生成图形或测量示例正确性。
zh.business_model: 公开价格、商业许可证与正式交付条款未确认。个人订阅、团队或接口收费都只是商业假设；多次修正成本与人工验收决定有效单价。
zh.traction: 具体输出示例支持定位，但没有取得独立评测、付费用户或重复工作数据。候补兴趣不等于稳定采用。
zh.moat: 可编辑结构和规格遵循可能比普通图像生成有价值。矢量设计工具、模板和其他生成模型都是替代，准确性要在真实专业任务中比较。
zh.funding_read: 资金可支持模型与产品化，下一里程碑应是开放使用和可复现专业任务。融资阶段不能证明候补后的正式产品已经可靠。
zh.risks: 数值或解剖标签错误可能误导读者，复杂 SVG 也可能难以编辑。修正次数过高会让速度优势失去意义。
zh.takeaway: 把生成目标定义为有结构、可验收和可继续编辑的交付物。针对一种专业视觉任务列清约束，优先减少人工改图。
zh.watch_next: 看首稿通过率、数值与结构错误、导入编辑成功和平均修改次数。将艺术表现与规格正确分开评测。

en.summary: Editable SVG generation from natural language and specifications.
en.judgment: Professional value requires correct, modifiable output; visual appeal alone cannot establish accuracy.
en.replaces: Manually drawing diagrams and adjusting labels, geometry and brand rules.
en.product: The site shows charts, scientific illustrations and product visuals with editable SVG claims. A waitlist remains the primary entry; full self-service purchase was not established.
en.customer: Designers, technical communicators and education teams are plausible users. Payment should reflect reduced corrections on recurring specified visuals rather than a faster first image.
en.workflow: The proposed workflow turns requirements into SVG. Text, numbers, geometric relationships and editing after import require testing; no generation or example validation was performed.
en.business_model: Prices, licenses and delivery terms were unavailable. Personal, team and API billing are hypotheses, with repeated revisions and inspection affecting effective cost.
en.traction: Concrete examples establish positioning without independent evaluation, payment or repeat-task data. Waitlist interest is not continuing adoption.
en.moat: Editable structure and specification compliance may differentiate it from image generation. Vector tools, templates and rival models need comparison on real professional tasks.
en.funding_read: Capital supports models and productization. Open access and reproducible professional evaluations are useful milestones; the round does not prove reliability after the waitlist.
en.risks: Wrong values or labels can mislead and complex SVG can be hard to modify. Excessive revisions can erase the speed advantage.
en.takeaway: Define structured, inspectable and editable deliverables. Constrain one professional visual task and reduce manual correction before widening scope.
en.watch_next: Watch first-pass acceptance, numerical and structural errors, editability after import and revision counts. Score expression separately from specification accuracy.
